subject: Social Media
title: Digital Detox Science
description: A quick, practical guide to Digital Detox Science.

hook.text: A study asked 143 students to limit social media to 30 minutes daily. After three weeks, loneliness dropped.

buildup.text: Digital detoxes range from strict—no phone for a week—to moderate: capped daily usage.

discovery.text: The moderate approach works better. Complete abstinence triggers withdrawal; limits build sustainable habits.

twist.text: Detox benefits fade quickly upon return. Without permanent changes, old patterns resume within days.

climax.text: The goal isn't quitting. It's restructuring your relationship with the tool—using it intentionally, not compulsively.

punchline.text: Less screen time beats no screen time.

quiz.question: What approach to digital detox works better according to research?
